_doc: Initiative 05 (de-string the AST leaves) burn-down worklist — the measurement that lands first and freezes the migration debt before the refactor starts. Enumerates every gold fixture that carries a free-text sink the initiative retires, grouped by sink. Card names are the gold's relative path under tests/magic-ast-tests/Fixtures/HandParsedCards/ (no .json), matching the NUnit test-case name (path separators normalised to '/'). Seeded 2026-06-15 over 951 golds. Superseded as the gate by the explicit named whitelist tests/magic-ast-tests/Fixtures/whitelist-freetext.json (de-ratcheted 2026-06-16); retained as the family-bucketed burndown worklist companion to libs/magic-ast/docs/gold-burndown-plan.md.
_method: Walked every committed gold JSON's Output subtree with System.Text.Json semantics. Free-text sinks are the AST's own [FreeTextField] markers (libs/magic-ast/AST/Residual.cs) — serialized JSON keys AbilityText / Instructions / Timeframe — plus the IResidual residual-arm nodes (OtherCharacteristic [CharacteristicType=other], OtherCondition [ConditionType=other], OtherHistoryPredicate [PredicateType=other]). GainAbilityEffect already carries a structured GainedAbility (Ability), not AbilityText, so it is not a live sink; KeywordSource string->KeywordAbility enum migration already landed (commit 1fe0848a), so the only remaining keyword-as-string representation is the AbilityText free-text sink (AbilityAdder).

summary._distinct_affected_cards_note: Union across all sinks below; less than the sum of per-sink card counts (151) because some cards carry more than one sink (e.g. 2X2/ManaVault appears in both Instructions and OtherCondition; LTR/MerryEsquireOfRohan and M21/BarrinTolarianArchmage in both OtherCharacteristic and OtherCondition).

AbilityText_token_subAST_as_string._note: TokenDefinition.AbilityText — the predefined-token sub-AST carried as raw oracle text (Treasure/Food/Clue/Blood). These are exactly the cards the hand-maintained PredefinedTokens.Registry (libs/mast-interaction) exists to shim; retiring the registry depends on these golds gaining a nested token Abilities sub-AST.

AbilityText_keyword_as_string_old_form._note: AbilityAdder.AbilityText (CopyModification, ModificationType=abilityAdder) — a granted keyword carried as the literal string 'haste' instead of the typed KeywordAbility enum. This is the deprecated/old-form keyword-identity representation that coexists with the canonical KeywordAbility enum (KeywordCharacteristic / KeywordAbilityEffect / KeywordSource). CONTRIBUTING.md names AbilityAdder as the remaining keyword-as-string site the enum is intended to absorb.

Instructions._note: SpellAbility.Instructions / TriggeredAbility.Instructions ([FreeTextField] List<string>) — interior free-text instruction lines on an otherwise-structured ability.

OtherCharacteristic._note: OtherCharacteristic residual arm (CharacteristicType=other) — an ObjectFilter constraint carried as a literal phrase because no structured Characteristic variant matched.

OtherCondition._note: OtherCondition residual arm (ConditionType=other) — a static/triggered-ability condition carried as a literal phrase because no structured Condition variant matched.

OtherHistoryPredicate._note: OtherHistoryPredicate residual arm (PredicateType=other) — a backward-looking lifecycle predicate carried as a literal phrase because no structured HistoryPredicate variant matched.
